title: Decision-Tree Surrogates for Weak Counterfactual Explanations in Integer Optimization
summary: The concept of counterfactual explanations (CEs) has recently gained increasing attention for deriving explanations of mathematical optimization problems. For a given problem, a counterfactual is an ideally minimal change in the mutable problem parameters such that an optimal solution of the changed problem exists fulfilling some desired criterion. It was shown that so-called weak CEs can be calculated by solving a computationally demanding bilevel optimization problem, which is $Σ_2^p$-complete if decision variables and mutable parameters are restricted to integers.
